meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 16-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (5 agents) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在发布前会先找出所有自上次发布以来改动的代码，派出最多 16 个智能体分组检查正确性、破坏性变更和风险，最后给出是否可发布和版本号建议。
howto.when: 只有当你明确要求做发布前审查时触发，比如说「pre-publish review」「review before publish」等；普通的发布请求不会触发。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reviews all unpublished changes before publishing: it detects code modified since last npm release, spawns up to 16 agents to check correctness, breaking changes, and risk, then gives a readiness verdict and version bump suggestion.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for a pre-publish review (e.g., 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish'). A plain publish request will not trigger it.

Review these changes for safety before publishing.
